bic_trace_step.reason: In rt1011_recv_spk_mode_put(), the commit adds `struct snd_soc_dapm_context *dapm = snd_soc_dapm_kcontrol_to_dapm(kcontrol);` (line 1050) without any NULL check. The kcontrol provided to this put function may not have an associated DAPM context, leading to a NULL pointer dereference when `dapm` is subsequently used in `snd_soc_dapm_get_bias_level(dapm)`. The vulnerability root cause exactly describes this scenario. No fix (like NULL check or alternative dapm retrieval) is present in this commit.
